# Effect: ring_mod

Ring modulator: multiplies with a sine wave for inharmonic metallic, bell and robot sounds.

**Where to put it**: Good for synths, drum effect sections and sci-fi sounds. At low frequencies (<30 Hz) it wobbles; at high ones it sounds metallic.

Latest parameters: `muser effects ring_mod` (MCP: `describe_effect`)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frequency_hz` | 440 | 0 – 5000 Hz | Carrier frequency. 20-30 wobble; 100-1000 metallic/bell |
| `mix` | 0.5 | 0 – 1 | Dry/wet mix. 1 leaves only the modulated sound |

All parameters can be omitted and take their default when omitted; when a value is out of range, `muser validate` reports the exact location.

## Minimal example

```json
{ "type": "ring_mod", "frequency_hz": 300, "mix": 0.4 }
```

## Scenario presets

- Bell / metallic

  ```json
  {"type": "ring_mod", "frequency_hz": 600, "mix": 0.5}
  ```

- Robot

  ```json
  {"type": "ring_mod", "frequency_hz": 90, "mix": 0.8}
  ```

- Slow tremble (low-frequency carrier)

  ```json
  {"type": "ring_mod", "frequency_hz": 18, "mix": 0.6}
  ```

## Tips and common mistakes

- The result is unrelated to pitch and almost always dissonant: use it for effects, fills and sci-fi sounds; use it carefully on melody tracks.
- Sweeping frequency_hz with automation produces very exaggerated metallic glides.
